summary: Iteration 8 — v8 pricing structure update. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (new defaults Creator $79/$780, Studio $199/$2028; founder block with cap=100, entry_fee=$1, tiers creator $49 / studio $149; founder_tier propagated into payment_transactions.metadata as 'studio' on POST /api/payments/checkout; default tier is 'creator' when omitted; bad tier 422; pricing migration applied — settings.pricing now matches v8 defaults; mongo verified directly). Frontend: ALL critical v8 features verified end-to-end. /pricing shows Creator $79 / Studio $199 / Solo $19 monthly; Yearly toggle correctly shows $65 (780/12), $169 (2028/12), $15; founder-banner renders with '97 of 100 spots remaining', '$1 once', '$49/mo Creator', '$149/mo Studio', and founder-banner-cta navigates to /founder-checkout. /founder-checkout: founder-spots shows '97 of 100 founder spots remaining' (teal accent), founder-tier-picker with creator/studio buttons, default selection is Creator ($49.00/mo), clicking Studio updates summary-tier-amt to '$149.00 / mo', updates 'Then $149/mo · Cancel anytime' subtitle, and applies purple border (rgb(123,79,212)) to Studio button while Creator stays at default border. Submit POST to /api/payments/checkout sends founder_tier='studio' in payload (verified via page.on('request') interception). Sold-out gate: mocked /api/pricing → available=false renders [data-testid='founder-soldout'] with [data-testid='soldout-see-pricing'] link and no form. /pricing with available=false renders [data-testid='founder-soldout-banner']. CEO Back Office /ceo Overview shows [data-testid='ceo-founder-stat'] = 'FOUNDER MEMBERS · 3 / 100 · 97 spots left' — 'Paid Revenue · mocked' card removed. No 'MOCKED' text on /pricing, /founder-checkout, or /ceo. Backend startup log confirms 'Migrated cached pricing to v8 defaults (Creator 79 / Studio 199 regular)'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2261-2273 — migration heuristic correctly detects legacy v7 numbers (creator.monthly==49 OR creator.yearly==468 OR studio.yearly==1908) and overwrites with DEFAULT_PRICING. Idempotent on re-runs since values then match v8. Good.

server.py:467 — CheckoutInitIn.founder_tier defaults to 'creator' via Pydantic; server.py:1626-1628 additionally guards `if founder_tier not in ('creator','studio'): founder_tier = 'creator'` — defensive double-check on _finalize_payment is correct.

server.py:1421-1427 — founder cap is enforced in /api/payments/checkout BEFORE the Stripe session is created. Good — prevents a 101st checkout session from ever opening. Note: this is not atomic against concurrent 100th+101st requests; a transactional count-and-insert would be safer but acceptable for now given the 1-time $1 model.
Pricing.jsx — Yearly /mo display uses Math.round(yearly/12) which produces 780/12=65 and 2028/12=169 exactly. Correct.
FounderCheckout.jsx — error 410 handling: setFounderStatus({available:false}) flips the render to <founder-soldout> on the next render without reload. Verified via mocked route. Good UX.
CEOBackOffice.jsx:165 — uses prop `testid` (not `data-testid`) which the StatCard component must forward as data-testid. Verified rendered DOM exposes [data-testid='ceo-founder-stat']. OK.
POST body interception shows the literal payload key `founder_tier`. Code review confirms server.py:1459 writes metadata.founder_tier from body.founder_tier. End-to-end propagation OK.
